$comment: Which package may depend on which (ADR 0006, 0008). Each package's package.json declares what it actually uses; `aue-check deps` (@aue/testkit) checks the declarations stay inside these lists and the graph has no cycle. Changing a line here is an architecture change: it needs an ADR.

math.role: exact arithmetic, deterministic math, the official rounding rules

schema.role: the interface formats between the simulation, the renderer and the network (versioned)

content.role: official content (the built-in mod), the Stronghold-compatible content interface, the registry

data.role: the data pipeline and the generated data

ui.role: the Unity UI prefab engine for the battle HUD

net.role: lockstep: client (worker) and server sides, protocol

worker.role: the worker entry and its build

simcheck.role: the cross-engine check (shared with Duel Channel and Stronghold Protocol)

sdk.role: the SDK for mod authors: the aue command line (new, check, test, pack), the mods' JSON Schemas

testkit.role: repository checks, Stronghold oracle, generators (dev only)
